| 1 | import re | Imports dependency modules: re. |
| 2 |  | Blank line used for readability and logical separation. |
| 3 | text = open(r'photo\doc_text_lines.txt', encoding='utf-8-sig', errors='ignore').read() | Assignment statement storing or updating program state. |
| 4 | lines = text.split('\n') | Assignment statement storing or updating program state. |
| 5 |  | Blank line used for readability and logical separation. |
| 6 | for line in lines: | Loop iterating over a sequence to process elements one by one. |
| 7 |     m = re.search(r'<w:t[^>]*>(.*)', line) | Assignment statement storing or updating program state. |
| 8 |     val = m.group(1).strip() if m else '' | Assignment statement storing or updating program state. |
| 9 |     is_sec = 'val="30"' in line | Assignment statement storing or updating program state. |
| 10 |     is_spacer = ('gridSpan' in line and not val) | Assignment statement storing or updating program state. |
| 11 |     fill_m = re.search(r'w:fill="([^"]+)"', line) | Assignment statement storing or updating program state. |
| 12 |     fill_col = fill_m.group(1) if fill_m else '' | Assignment statement storing or updating program state. |
| 13 |     if val: | Conditional branch that runs only when its condition is true. |
| 14 |         tag = '[SEC]' if is_sec else '    ' | Assignment statement storing or updating program state. |
| 15 |         print(tag, '['+fill_col+']', repr(val)) | Operational statement participating in the file's runtime behavior. |
| 16 |     elif is_spacer: | Conditional branch that runs only when its condition is true. |
| 17 |         print('[---SPACER---]') | Operational statement participating in the file's runtime behavior. |
